content.summary: Run the full regression against the unchanged version 1 comparison implementation after G2 completes and its deep receipt audit passes. Preserve this bounded comparison as a development diagnostic and then execute the separately tested version 2 repair plan.
findings: The baseline ladder receives identical public source and factual declarations without hidden expressions or reference scenarios. All sixteen jobs and failures must be retained; finite reference recovery cannot serve as legal correctness or a method ranking.
All-abstention results cannot establish a safe automatic acceptance rate. Unresolved input meanings and incorporated authorities remain explicit despite shared formulas.

Isolated tests reproduced missing propagation of reading-level questions, failure to reconsider conflicting supported programs, and failure to supply rejected proposals to the reviser. These are implementation defects assigned to the H0 repair, not grounds for erasing the frozen diagnostic or stopping the repair direction.

The version 1 completion path can accept local verification after the issue deadline; a simulated-clock test and staged repair cover this boundary. Actual study jobs remain subject to their recorded durations and phase deadline.

G3 validates the existing regression under a 900-second command deadline, in trusted context after the earlier TestClient startup incident. A timeout remains a preserved failure requiring diagnosis; no unlimited wait or silent reset is permitted.

Passing G3 completes the engineering record for this historical version. It does not promote version 1 as the final product method. Archive its implementation before installing H0, run focused repairs and a live product-command check, then validate the final full suite.
